scope: Sanitized numeric evidence only. Private IDs, text, paths, profiles, screenshots, and payload hashes omitted.

environment.build: Built Vite assets; Rust release opt-level=2, thin LTO, codegen-units=1, stripped; automation-devtools enabled
environment.cache: Existing process after first visit; indexes warm; OS cache uncontrolled

nativeIndexing.method: Real release Tauri app. Native lifecycle events timestamped in renderer; list readiness includes two animation frames. First setup starts with absent database and fresh WebView profile. Full rebuilds use the existing process, Settings reads settled and auto-refresh disabled. OS cache uncontrolled; no cold-disk/process-startup or before/after speedup claim. Correctness checks run after timing.
notes: One first-setup sample per corpus; three full-rebuild samples. Massive validation includes exact expected search/content counts and native FTS integrity check.

Initial scripted rebuild calls while Settings read its database failed with Windows sharing violation on 100/1000-session corpora. Subsequent samples wait for Settings storage stats; those failed attempts are not successful timings.

diagnostic.method: Separate native full rebuild with debug logging; excluded from accepted samples. Maintenance timers exclude ANALYZE.

massiveDesktop.method: First visit and three warm revisits in one existing native process after indexing; 1440x960, no CPU throttle. Hash-route-to-rendered-content with two animation frames. Warm search revisits may reuse cached results/facets; not uncached SQLite query timings.

diagnosticProfile.note: Separate diagnostic profile; synchronous geometry reads charge browser layout to the read. Not proof that all this time is removable.
